showcase.user_prompt: 做一款从上往下看的迷宫探索小游戏，先能走起来。
showcase.assistant_reply: Origin Game Studio 会先澄清手感，再落地 canvas2d 脚手架、启动舞台并按里程碑验证。

items.title: 设计图与舞台
items.description: 设计图是整份计划；舞台是正在运行的游戏，可用探针单步、点选和读回状态。

items.title: 脚手架与探针
items.description: canvas2d / three 第一方脚手架自带确定性循环和 postMessage 探针。

items.title: 里程碑评估
items.description: 每个里程碑是一份 Evaluation Definition，criteria 指向构建命令或遥测断言。

showcase.user_prompt: Make a top-down maze explorer that I can walk around first.
showcase.assistant_reply: Origin Game Studio will clarify feel, land the canvas2d scaffold, open the stage, and verify against milestones.

items.title: Design graph and stage
items.description: The design graph is the plan; the stage is the running game you can step, pick and read back.

items.title: Scaffold and probe
items.description: First-party canvas2d / three scaffolds ship a deterministic loop and a postMessage probe.

items.title: Milestone evaluation
items.description: Each milestone is an Evaluation Definition whose criteria point at a build command or a telemetry assertion.
